summary.text: Ryan Lauer is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 59, which he has represented since November 2018, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Josh Burbrink as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Lauer graduated from Indiana University with a B.S. in biochemistry.

He was elected to the Bartholomew County Council in 2010 and became its president in 2014, and he also served on the Bartholomew County Sheriff's Merit Board and the Community Corrections Advisory Board.

Outside public service, he worked as a technical specialist at Cummins, and he has been involved in the American Chemical Society, the National Rifle Association and the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers.
Lauer took office in the Indiana House on November 7, 2018, succeeding Milo Smith.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Family, Children and Human Affairs Committee and as a member of the Financial Institutions and Insurance and Veterans Affairs and Public Safety committees.
